Boss Saif, salam!  

**Aaj ka schedule (Stowave team ke liye)**  

| Time | Kaam / Meeting | Details |
|------|----------------|---------|
| 10:00 AM | **Daily Stand‑up** | Saif, Waqar, Ali Haider, Ali Husnain aur Ali Zohaib sab mil ke 15 min ka quick update. Sprint progress, blockers aur priorities discuss karenge. |
| 11:30 AM | **Product Sync** | Product team ke saath feature roadmap review. New UI mockups aur testing feedback. |
| 01:00 PM | **Lunch Break** | Relax ho jao, energy recharge! |
| 02:00 PM | **Client Call – XYZ Corp** | Account manager ke saath contract renewal aur upcoming deliverables pe baat. Saif ko lead role assign kiya gaya hai. |
| 03:30 PM | **Tech Review** | Dev team (Ali Haider & Ali Husnain) ke saath code quality aur CI/CD pipeline update. |
| 04:45 PM | **Marketing Update** | Waqar Hassan ke saath campaign performance aur next week ke promos plan. |
| 05:30 PM | **Wrap‑up & Q&A** | Sab ko open floor milta hai koi bhi issue ya idea share karne ke liye. |

**Aaj ke alawa koi extra kaam**  
- **Documentation**: Project wiki ko latest sprint notes se update karna hai (Ali Zohaib ne suggest kiya tha).  
- **Bug Triage**: JIRA board pe high priority bugs ko prioritize karna.  
- **Team Pulse**: Slack pe short poll bhejna “Aaj ka workload kaisa lag raha hai?” – taaki sab ki feel jaan sake.

Koi aur task ya koi change chahiye ho toh bas bata dena, Boss. 😎
